The MESH equations of every stage were solved together by Newton's method (Naphtali-Sandholm), started by the continuation in the relative volatilities (4 steps), in 7 iterations; every group of residuals is within its tolerance (state.residuals). Converged is not validated against data: the result is as good as the method and its parameters.
Side draw: 1: 4542 kmol/h of the liquid of stage 2 (337.3 K). A side draw has the composition of its stage's liquid; the liquid and vapour flows of the profile are those that go on to the next stage.

PR is the method here: Carbon dioxide is a light gas, which only an equation of state describes (gas-phase reactors and high-pressure loops are simulated so). For a liquid of the polar components alone (Methanol, Water) below about 10 bar, such as their distillation, an activity model (NRTL or UNIQUAC) would be more accurate (docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md).
